workflow.description: The layered workflow (layout, headers, hierarchy) the shared builder reads the spread with, as a generic_text conversion declares it (ingestion/generic/workflow.schema.json).

unit_words.description: Unit words printed after an amount on its line (`7,000 千円`): taken off before the layout is read.

counters.description: Counters of a count wrapped to a line of its own (`22 回`): such a leaf with no amount is no item.
